title: DiscordPlus
description: Enhances your Minecraft server with advanced Discord integration, providing synchronized chat, configurable notifications and moderation tools. Makes it easier for players to stay connected and manage your community across platforms.
body:
# DiscordPlus – Ultimate Minecraft‑Discord Integration

**Seamlessly integrate your server with Discord!**

## ✨ Main Features

- **Account Linking**: Bind Discord and Minecraft accounts.
- **Role Synchronization**: Automatically manage roles with LuckPerms.
- **Chat Bridge**: Two‑way chat between Minecraft and Discord.
- **Statistics**: Player data and leaderboards.
- **Vote System**: Automatic reward distribution.
- **GUI Menus**: User‑friendly interface.

## 🛠 Technical Info

- **Minecraft**: 1.16.5–1.20.1 (1.20.1 recommended)
- **Platform**: Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Bukkit
- **Language**: Turkish & English
- **Database**: H2 (embedded)

## 🔧 Commands

- `/verify` – Link your Discord account
- `/dpgui` – Open the main menu
- `/sync` – Synchronize roles
- `/stats` – View statistics

## 🔌 Integrations

- **LuckPerms** (Role sync)
- **Vault** (Economy)
- **PlaceholderAPI** (Placeholders)

## 🚀 Installation

1. Place the plugin in the `plugins/` folder.  
2. Add your Discord bot token to `config.yml`.  
3. Restart the server.  
4. Finish setup with `/dpgui`.  

## 🤝 Support

- **Discord**: [Lora Community](https://discord.gg/bgHexr9rk5)  
- **Website**: [kynux.dev](https://kynux.dev)  

**Try the ultimate Discord integration today!**
